candidate_relations.reason: Mucormycosis is an incompatible mold infection for the reference histoplasmosis causing lip ulcers in HIV.
Mucicarmine stain was negative, and the reference organism is Histoplasma not Cryptococcus.
Undetectable HCV viral load is virologic clearance, not histoplasmosis.
Granulomatous cheilitis of Melkersson-Rosenthal is a differential for lip swelling, not histoplasmosis.
Acid-fast stain was negative, so Mycobacterium avium complex infection is not supported.
Painful heaped ulcers in advancing HIV/IRIS timing are not cheilitis glandularis.
Coccidioidomycosis is a different dimorphic fungus from Histoplasma.
Marked lip edema and ulcers are cheilitis without histoplasmosis.
